$comment: Map generator settings (scripts/game/mapgen.js). The same seed gives the same map on every machine: value noise built from integer hashing only. elevation = noise(scale) - falloff * (distance from the centre)^2; below thresholds.water is water, below thresholds.sand is sand. On land, a second noise (rockScale) above thresholds.rock is rock, else a third (moistureScale) above thresholds.forest is forest, else grass. A 5 x 5 patch of grass is always left in the middle. Look at a seed with: factoria call --project . project.map_preview '{"seed": 7}'.
